lines.zh: 我飘着走，脚尖离地一点。
lines.en: I float along with my toes just off the ground.

lines.zh: 我个子小，可在空中很稳。
lines.en: I am small, but steady in the air.

lines.zh: 我抱着手臂，慢慢往前飘。
lines.en: I drift forward with my arms folded.
My red cheeks burn in the wind.
I always trail behind him.
I say nothing; I just follow.

lines.zh: 我飘过草地，草只弯了一点点。
lines.en: I pass over the grass and it only bends a little.

lines.zh: 我抬头看天，再低头看路。
lines.en: I look at the sky, then at the path.

lines.zh: 我绕开一块石头，绕得很远。
lines.en: I go far around a stone.
I drift slowly so I do not get lost.
Ki holds me up from below.
I drift to your flank without a sound.
I hang there without moving.
My fingers fidget inside my sleeve.
I blink and look into the distance.
I am a little nervous.
I count silently.
Ki turns gently around me.
I touch my hat.

lines.zh: 我抬头看有没有人过来。
lines.en: I look up to see if anyone is coming.

lines.zh: 我屏住呼吸，听周围的动静。
lines.en: I hold my breath and listen.
I murmur something under my breath.
My shoulders hunch.

lines.zh: 我一直没离开这个位置。
lines.en: I have not moved from this spot.
I wait for his signal.
I look at my own pale hands.
I have to strain to look up at you.
Who are you?
I drift aside a little.
Do not move suddenly.
Must we fight?
I am small, but I am not weak.

lines.zh: 你这样看着我，我很不舒服。
lines.en: You staring at me is uncomfortable.
What are you laughing at?

lines.zh: 我抬起头，把下巴收回去。
lines.en: I lift my head and tuck my chin in.
Your ki is heavy.
I do not like this place.

lines.zh: 你要是不动手，我也不动。
lines.en: If you do not strike, neither will I.
I keep waiting for him to say it is fine.
I curl up from the pain.
I drift backward.
I bite my lip.
That one landed solidly.
I clutch the wound.
I look up at you.
I will not cry.

lines.zh: 被打中一次，下次就躲开了。
lines.en: You hit me once. I'll dodge the next one.
I shake my head.
Put it away.
I look, but do not reach.
That is not how he taught me.
I put my hands behind my back.
That is of no use to me.
I sniff and wrinkle my nose.
Do not test me with this.
Your bump sends me drifting aside.

lines.zh: 我撞在你背上，弹了一下。
lines.en: I hit your back and bounce.
I rise quickly.
Let me through.
My hat is askew.
I catch hold of a nearby tree.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，我太小了。
lines.en: We collide, and I am far too small.
You nearly knocked me over.
I steady myself and drift on.
I have known him a long time.
We always show up together.
I am not good at being alone.
When he speaks, I listen beside him.
I tug his sleeve.
We do not need many words.
I follow his shadow.
With him here, I do not panic.

lines.zh: 我飘到他前面，又退回去。
lines.en: I drift ahead of him, then fall back.
It is dark; we should go.
I lift it with my ki.
A pity to leave it on the ground.
I carry it along for a while.
I did not dare pick it up with bare hands.
I tuck it into my sleeve.
This one can be kept.
I can carry it; it is small.
I hold it up for him to see.
I look, then put it back.
Did you drop something? Let me get it.
I raise my palm toward you.
He told me to strike.
Do not blame me for this.
I take a breath.
My eyes lock onto you.
I rise a little.
This one will not be light.
I am sorry, but I must.
I raise my hand overhead.
The ki begins to burn.
Stand still.
My ki is ready.
Come.
I arc around you.
My ki blast grazes your shoulder.

lines.zh: 你比我高很多，可我不怕。
lines.en: You are much taller, but I am not afraid.
I drift behind you.
I keep watching your feet.
I raise a hand, then lower it.
I am looking for a gap.
Your movements are too fast.
I retreat behind a tree.
I am gathering ki.

lines.zh: 你转身的时候，我就出手。
lines.en: When you turn, I strike.
I float higher to see better.
I have not let my guard down.

lines.zh: 我再靠近一点，气功激光已经瞄准。
lines.en: A little closer; my ki laser is aimed.
The blast has taken shape.
I wait for you to tire.
My fingers are trembling.
My palm strikes you.
Ki pours out of my hand.

lines.zh: 我撞进你怀里，把你顶退。
lines.en: I ram into your chest and push you back.
You blocked it.
I strike and float upward.
I am breathing hard.
My ki has not dispersed.
Sorry, one more.
My sleeve is torn open.
The recoil numbs my hand.
I grit my teeth and push.
It is clumsy, but it works.
I cannot get my feet down.
I raise my hand again.

lines.zh: 我从一片气雾里浮出来。
lines.en: I float out of a haze of ki.
My feet never touch the ground.
This place is brighter than I expected.
I open my eyes and look around.

lines.zh: 气在我身体外面转了一圈。
lines.en: Ki circles outside my body.
I sink, then rise again.
I blink and come awake slowly.
Someone put me here.
I fold my arms and wait.

lines.zh: 我的影子很小，浮在草上。
lines.en: My small shadow floats over the grass.

lines.zh: 我抬头看太阳，眯起眼睛。
lines.en: I look at the sun and squint.
The wind lifts my hem.
I hear someone calling me.
I appear without a sound.

lines.zh: 我的帽子歪了，我扶正它。
lines.en: My hat is crooked; I straighten it.
I turn around, looking for him.

lines.zh: 空气里有一阵轻微的嗡鸣。
lines.en: There is a faint hum in the air.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的衣服，我拍了两下。
lines.en: Flame catches my clothes and I slap at them.
I hit the ground and bounce.

lines.zh: 水把我往下拖，我使劲挣。
lines.en: Water drags me down and I struggle.
The blast blows me far away.
An arrow grazes my arm.

lines.zh: 咒光打中我，我的气散了一半。
lines.en: Spell-light hits and half my ki scatters.
Hunger makes my head swim.
Lightning falls and my whole body goes numb.

lines.zh: 我往下坠，抓不到任何东西。
lines.en: I fall, and there is nothing to catch.
